venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CC ATL — Monday, July 20, 2026** — MOD MKZ. Quiet Monday; MOD covered the opening bar shift. A few couples joined early in the evening — one duo loved the mezcal selection and talked through back-bar bottles. Cleaning projects executed plus glassware ABK now that the projector screen is off the back bar; more coupes and collins glasses on the way, with DOF/TOF/martini glasses pulled from storage to replenish. Ended the night with industry friends stopping in for a nightcap; a slow, steady Monday that allowed the team to be more curious and conversational. Kitchen: lighter seasoning on the jojos going forward. 86'd: wings. Favorite moment: a group of 4 from OneTrust upstairs loved the chill atmosphere and are excited to return for Summer Friday. Comps: manager comp $12 (jojos too spicy) + industry love $2.10 = $14.10.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Monday, July 20, 2026** — MOD KE. A decent Monday, steady throughout the day. First dozen guests were two parties of business folks on happy hour cocktails; also hosted a 21st birthday. Most guests were first-timers or relatively new. Comps $14.60 / 1.12%. 86'd: lassi mix; low tonic. Favorite moment: complimented for the best dirty martini ever ('because I shake the shit outta it') — a dubious distinction gladly accepted.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Monday, July 20, 2026** — AM MOD Carey & Josh; PM MOD Maggie H & Rachel. DC/AM sales $1,084.66; D&C (PM) $9,320.09. Busy busy busy — never a dull moment; Ryan continuing to kill it, shadowed Madi tonight. Incident outside the building with an intoxicated man (did not drink here) harassing lobby guests; staff managed it outside with zero damage, police called but he was gone. Kitchen ran out of a lot — triple-check prep lists; 86'd mango tarts, lamb, spinach dip, basil vinaigrette, ranch, pesto, burger meat. Maintenance: host stand leg came unscrewed. Event tomorrow: TriNet, ~30 guests, 3-6pm in Suite 6A — coffee and hot water/creamers ready at 3pm.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday, July 20, 2026** — MOD Michael. A surprisingly busy evening on a true skeleton crew — steady and busy, gorgeous summer weather. Filled in gradually, full and popping by 8:30pm; stayed full until 10:30pm with the bar full until midnight. Ran out of the dip for chips-and-dip. Lots of out-of-towners left very happy, including many Denver-location fans visiting EV for the first time. Welcomed new member Gabriel, long-time regulars Perry and Laura (visiting since 2007) celebrating their anniversary, and three birthday celebrations. Comps $431 — lots of extra hospitality and a few DNLs. Kitchen: snacks only, FOH team MVP. No no-shows.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Monday, July 20, 2026** — MOD Joe + Josh + Vic. Another successful Oyster Monday — sold 80 oysters in the first half hour and it was nonstop until ~10pm, selling through everything by 10:30pm for a total of 233 (most oysters ever sold — could have sold more). Bar top filled early with $2-oyster crowd; room filled by 9pm with a small waitlist worked through quickly. Final shift with Ruffy, who will be dearly missed; Edwin handled the host stand with ease. 86'd oysters. Comps $130 (Ryan, Griffin, Raymundo, Jeffrey, Sean, Joanna, staff food, DNL). Reported guest check average $72.31 (per report).

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Monday, July 20, 2026** — MOD Jesse. Marquee bar sales $2,644.92; total sales $2,918.43. Smooth night in the alley — light foot traffic, energy stayed high but the room never fully seated; folks recovering from celebrating Spain's World Cup win. 69 guests (24 covers, 45 walk-ins). Discounts $48.94 (1.8%, investor); voids $129 (4.9%, entry errors on the new Toast system — some 1oz/2oz pours priced inverted; bar KDS buffering between drinks). Kitchen chill; 86'd olives late pending new marinade. Maintenance: syrup prep fridge running at 12°F (produce moved, Tyler checking tomorrow), bar under-lights out, bowed wood panel above service well, a couple of mice after hours. Favorite moment: community member Cameron relaxing and chopping it up with the team.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday, July 20, 2026** — AM MOD Sam & Shannon; PM MOD Braden & Marcus. Municipal Bar morning $1,038 (50 guests); evening $2,208 (40 guests); Sun Club $362; Hot Eye closed. Slow morning with hotel-guest breakfasts and a couple of helpful food tours; steady scattered lunch 11am-3pm on one server until noon. Very slow evening — mid servers cut at 6 and 8; small pop ~7:30/8; team studied 50-cocktails and did ABK work in the downtime. Sun Club slow; all umbrellas working now; needs more grenadine in the morning. Kitchen used the slow night for a deep clean of the line; 86'd branzino until tomorrow. Maintenance: window squeegee needed.
